title: Wildfire
tldr: Check evacuation notices for your address. Leave promptly when ordered, using the current official route; do not delay for possessions. If a fire threatens your escape or you are trapped, call emergency services with your precise location.
steps: Use fire agency and emergency management alerts rather than old perimeter maps.
Take essential medicines, identification, keys and phone power without delaying departure.
Smoke and closures can change quickly; do not drive into heavy smoke or flames.
Tell an out-of-area contact where you are going and follow shelter instructions.
next: Return only when reentry is allowed. Check for damaged utilities, hot debris and continuing smoke.
watch: A smoke-control room cannot protect you from a fire approaching the building.
